response.overview: This is an audiovisual archive containing stories, people, communities, and knowledge from diverse communities in the Peruvian highlands and Amazon. The videos were produced by members of peasant organizations between 2000 and 2008. These organizations, known as Andean Cultural Affirmation Centers, participated in research projects on Andean and Amazonian knowledge, seeking to highlight and reflect the cultural diversity, knowledge, and wisdom of the peoples who have maintained their Andean roots and worldview to this day.
response.title: Saberes Andinos y Amazónicos
